mode_inference_decision.rationale: Existing skinned character receives licensed skeletal motion; no bitmap or replacement geometry is generated.

source_brief: Test official subject 16 walk (31) and run/jog (35), both 120 Hz. Replace rejected bounding run clips only if source reconstruction and target silhouette pass.

license.verification: Verified and archived official-home.html; free use including commercial games, no direct resale of motion data or converted motion data. This is the CMU site's own use permission, not a CC0 claim.
license.acknowledgment: Motion data obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.

alpha_policy: Not applicable: motion data only; existing character materials and textures remain unchanged.

retarget_scope.method: Absolute segment bases, source ASF direction and anatomical reference to target child offset and rest-model +X reference.
retarget_scope.body: Root/lowerback/upperback rest deltas move pelvis/spine_01/spine_02; spine_03 world facing remains the calibrated frozen rifle rest.
retarget_scope.translation: Source mean hip height/lateral offset scaled by total leg length; recorded root XZ travel is removed for in-place review only.
retarget_scope.toe_articulation: Not transferred; target ball has no child bone and requires a separately validated anatomical terminal direction.
retarget_scope.contact: Not accepted: source captures and target shoes have different offsets; observed target penetration up to 11.7 mm.
retarget_scope.loop: Full recordings play once. No seamless loop, engine-speed retiming, start/stop, strafe or runtime integration accepted.

requirements: Download only official HTTPS files with normal certificate verification; verify bytes and SHA-256 before processing.
Preserve raw files and source/license evidence outside runtime.
Reconstruct root and all fixed hip offsets, bone axes, channel order and lengths using a verified ASF/AMC convention.
TDD: synthetic known rotations, nonzero bone axes, ordered root rotations, missing channels and malformed hierarchy; cross-check true source poses before retargeting.
Use 0.0254/0.45 meters per source length unit, verified by official CMU documentation.

Retarget actual leg segment directions using calibrated anatomical bases; raw world-space rest deltas are insufficient for CMU's 20-degree rest splay. Preserve hierarchy, local bone positions/scales, hands and rifle.
Inspect full motion continuously and source-target poses, then assess cycle extraction, contact, start/stop and full gameplay cost separately.
Do not treat a short recorded clip as a seamless loop or normalize away defects to force visual acceptance.
